description: List channels, including each epic's implicit `epic/<id>` channel, with their membership, by name. An auto-created channel with no members is hidden (counted in `hiddenEmpty`) unless `includeEmpty: true`. Paged: at most `limit` (default 100) from `offset`; `nextOffset` is null on the last page.

offset.description: Skip this many first; pass the last nextOffset to page on.

name: channel_list
title: List channels
